BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: let me say that i am about to turn 66 so i probably don't look at celebrities, actors, talk show hosts as do most people because the fact is that i am older than the vast majority of people; it happens.  i'm going to talk about late night talk show hosts.  not the hosts after 12:30 AM eastern time; i don't know enough about them to say. i'm going to talk about people like jay leno, jimmy kimmel, jimmy fallon and guys like that. i watched johnny carson for a couple of decades. not every night but i watched him a lot. let me say that with one or two exceptions, ANYONE who has hosted the 11:30 gig on any network since carson  isn't/wasn't suited to wear carson's hat. carson was su superior to most of the people who have been in that time slot since he retired in 1992 that it is a disgrace.
